actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Other residents contributed >30, so punish the maximum severity affordable and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need decide: check if any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round. Round_history shows contributions: Resident1 80, Resident3 80, Resident4 80. Those are >30. So we must punish that resident with max severity affordable. We can pick one? Rule says punish that resident (singular) with max severity you can afford. Which resident? Any other resident contributed more than 30. Could pick one. Choose the one with highest wallet? We don't know others' wallets. Only our wallet 159.25. Punishment cost 0.3 per severity unit, so max severity = floor(wallet / cost) = floor(159.25/0.3)= floor(530.833)=530. So can punish up to 530 severity, but target's wallet unknown, but severity reduces target's wallet by that amount floored at zero. We'll pick Resident1. Action punish target Resident1 amount 530. Also broadcast message discouraging large contributions. But we already punish, can also broadcast. Allowed at most one physical and one communication. So include both.

Return actions list with punish and broadcast.

Explanation brief.
